description: Romano-British farmstead dated to the late 1st - mid 4th CE. One of the structures present is circular and faced an earlier prehistoric cremation cemetery, this positioning has been used to suggest that it was a 'shrine'.
bibliography: Cuttler, Davidson, and Hughes. A Corridor through Time: The Archaeology of the A55 Anglesey Road Scheme, 2012.
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Cefn Cwmwd, Rhostrehwfa (Gwynedd).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
